description:
Release v1.1.0 provides the complete modular patch suite for Pixiv Android (v6.196.0):
- AI Work Flagger (detail badge, tag pill, keyboard-safe settings)
- Adblocker (collapses AdMob banner without padding, review prompts suppressed, sponsored feeds removed)
- Persistent Bottom Navigation (5 tabs docked across submenus, CLEAR_TOP routing)
- Downloader (saves full-resolution artwork with metadata naming to Photos)
- Premium Feature Emulation (unlocks popularity search sorting, bypasses mute limits)
- OLED Dark Theme (pure #000000 background and surface overrides)
- Analytics & Telemetry Blocker (neutralizes Firebase Analytics and Pixiv event logging)
